title: Top 10 Saving Account Refer and Earn in India 2026
summary: Saving account refer and earn in India 2026: AU, DBS, Axis, Kotak 811, IDFC FIRST and GroMo compared, exact rewards, the 3 payout rules, and how to earn Rs 1,000 fast.
body_markdown:
Saving account refer and earn programs pay you when a friend opens an account through your link: banks like AU, DBS, and Axis reward Rs 250 vouchers or points per referral through their own apps, while distribution platforms like GroMo pay Rs 100 to 500 in direct cash per activated account, across many banks at once, with no referral cap. Every payout hinges on three rules: the friend must complete full video KYC, meet any funding minimum, and be genuinely new to that bank.


Here are the top 10 programs for 2026, with the exact rewards, the fine print that decides whether you actually get paid, and why GroMo is the pick if you want to do this seriously.


## Saving account refer and earn: quick facts


Question Quick answer


Typical reward Rs 250 per referral on bank apps, Rs 100 to 500 cash on GroMo


Reward type Banks pay vouchers and points, GroMo pays bank-transfer cash


Referral caps Bank apps cap you (AU: 20 referrals), distribution platforms do not


What triggers payment Completed video KYC, funding minimums met, new-to-bank customer


Zero balance accounts? Yes, most referred digital accounts are zero balance variants


Do you need your own account? On bank apps yes, on GroMo no


## The 3 rules that decide whether you get paid


**Video KYC completion.** Almost every digital savings account referral pays only after the referee finishes full Aadhaar and PAN linked video verification. A friend who downloads, registers, and stops at KYC earns you nothing, so your real job is walking them through the 10-minute VKYC call.


**Funding or transaction minimums.** Some programs add a spend condition, DBS requires a Rs 2,000 transaction on the physical debit card within the window. Read each program's trigger before promising your friend anything.


**New-to-bank only.** The person you refer must have no existing relationship with that bank, no old account, credit card, or loan. This is the silent killer of referral payouts, and it is exactly why multi-bank platforms win: one friend can only be new to a bank once, but on GroMo you match each person to a bank they have never used.

5. Kotak 811 Varies by campaign, in-app 811 zero balance account activation

### 1. GroMo, the serious earner's program


GroMo is not a bank's referral scheme, it is a distribution platform where banks pay you cash commission for every savings account you help open, the same channel professional agents use. That difference changes everything about the economics, and it gets a full section below.


**Reward:** typically Rs 100 to 500 per activated account, credited as real money to your bank account, not vouchers or points.


### 2. AU Small Finance Bank (AU Refer-A-Friend)


**Reward:** Rs 250 Amazon Pay gift voucher each, for both you and your friend.


**How it works:** generate your unique link in the AU 0101 app, your friend opens an AU savings account through it successfully.


**Limit:** capped at 20 successful referrals, so the program maxes out at Rs 5,000 in vouchers.


### 3. DBS Bank (digibank Invite and Earn)


**Reward:** Rs 250 cashback or credit for both you and your friend.


**How it works:** share your personalised invitation link, your friend must open a digiSavings account within 15 days and complete a transaction of at least Rs 2,000 using the physical debit card. That spend condition is the step most missed, tell your friend upfront.


### 4. Axis Bank Digital Savings Account Program


**Reward:** 1,250 EDGE REWARD points for you, and welcome perks worth around Rs 250 for your friend.


**How it works:** log into the Axis Mobile app, open Refer a Friend, share the digital savings invite link, and your friend completes the Axis online VKYC account opening.


### 5. Kotak 811 refer and earn


Kotak's 811 zero balance account runs referral campaigns inside the Kotak app, with rewards that change by campaign rather than a fixed public rate. Check the refer section of the app for the live offer before sharing, and note the reward triggers on full 811 activation, not just registration.


### 6. IDFC FIRST Bank saving account refer and earn


IDFC FIRST runs refer-a-friend campaigns through its mobile app for savings accounts, with rewards varying by campaign period. Its accounts are an easy referral pitch, the bank's interest rates on savings run higher than most large banks, so the account sells itself once the friend compares.


### 7 to 10. Fi Money, Jupiter, IndusInd, Freo Save


The neobanks, Fi and Jupiter (both built on Federal Bank), Freo Save, and IndusInd's digital account all run in-app referral campaigns with rewards that rotate too often to quote reliably. They share one virtue: fully digital VKYC opening that a friend can finish in minutes, which keeps your completion rate, and therefore your payouts, high. Check each app's refer section for the live reward.


## Why GroMo is the best way to refer saving accounts


Every bank program above has the same three ceilings: one bank's product only, vouchers or points instead of money, and caps like AU's 20 referrals. GroMo removes all three, which is why it is the right tool the moment you want more than pocket change.


**Cash, not coupons.** Commissions credit to your bank account as withdrawable money. A voucher locks your earning to one shopping site, cash does not care.


**Many banks from one app.** The GroMo catalogue carries zero balance and premium savings accounts from multiple partner banks, names like AU Small Finance Bank, IndusInd, Axis, IDFC FIRST, Fi, Jupiter, and Freo have featured, with exact availability and payout per account varying by live partner campaigns, the app shows the current rate card. This matters because of the new-to-bank rule: a friend who already banks with Axis is worthless to the Axis program, but on GroMo you simply offer them AU or Fi instead. One contact list, many chances to earn.


**No caps, no own-account requirement.** Bank apps need you to be their customer and stop paying after a limit. GroMo needs one free KYC, and there is no ceiling, the model is built for volume, which is how agents turn account referrals into the base layer of a real side income, as the[sell financial products and earn money](https://gromo.in/blog/sell-financial-products-and-earn-money/) playbook shows.


**The cross-sell ladder.** A savings account is the easiest first product, free for the friend, 10 minutes of VKYC. On GroMo the same customer can later take a credit card or loan through you, each paying its own commission, an upgrade path no single bank's referral scheme offers. The same logic runs across[demat account refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/demat-account-refer-and-earn/) and[credit card refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-refer-and-earn/) .


## How to refer and earn Rs 1,000 fast


The realistic maths for a refer and earn 1000 target: four AU referrals (Rs 1,000 in vouchers), four DBS conversions (Rs 1,000 cashback), or two to four activated accounts on GroMo depending on the live rates, in cash. Most people find the GroMo route fastest at small scale for one reason: you can offer each friend whichever bank they do not already use, so fewer conversations die on the new-to-bank rule.


Past Rs 1,000, the bank apps hit caps and repeat-referral fatigue, while the distributor route keeps scaling, the wider ranking of programs by payout is in[high paying refer and earn apps](https://gromo.in/blog/high-paying-refer-and-earn-apps/) .

## FAQ: saving account refer and earn


**1. Which bank gives money for refer and earn on a savings account?**
AU (Rs 250 Amazon voucher both sides, capped at 20), DBS (Rs 250 cashback both sides), and Axis (1,250 EDGE points) have the clearest standing offers, while Kotak 811, IDFC FIRST, and the neobanks run rotating campaigns. GroMo pays Rs 100 to 500 in direct cash per activated account across multiple banks.


**2. What is the best refer and earn bank account zero balance offer?**
Kotak 811, AU's digital account, and the neobank accounts are all zero balance, which makes the pitch easy. The best offer depends on which bank your friend has never used, that new-to-bank rule matters more than the headline reward.


**3. How does account opening refer and earn actually pay?**
The chain is: friend clicks your link, opens the account, completes video KYC, meets any funding condition, and the program credits your reward, vouchers and points on bank apps, bank-transfer cash on GroMo. Bank account open refer and earn offers never pay on registration alone, activation is the trigger.


**4. Can I refer and earn 1000 rupees in a week?**
Yes, realistically: four completed AU or DBS referrals, or two to four activated accounts through GroMo. The bottleneck is your friends finishing VKYC, so help them do it on the spot instead of sending a link and hoping.


**5. Is there a bank account referral program in India without a referral cap?**
Bank-run programs are capped or campaign-limited, AU stops at 20 referrals. Distribution platforms like GroMo have no referral ceiling because banks treat them as an acquisition channel, not a promotion.


**6. Which refer and earn apps list should I start from?**
Start with one bank app you already use (AU, Axis, Kotak) for the easy first vouchers, then add GroMo for uncapped cash earnings across banks. The full cross-category ranking is in our[refer and earn apps in India](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-and-earn-apps-in-india/) guide.


**7. Why did my referral reward not come?**
Three usual reasons: the friend stopped before completing video KYC, a funding or first-transaction condition was not met, or the friend was not new to that bank. Check the program's tracking screen, every serious app shows per-referral status.


**8. Do I need my own account in the bank to refer?**
On bank apps, yes, the referral link generates from inside your logged-in mobile banking app. On GroMo, no, one KYC lets you offer accounts from many banks without holding any of them.
